reconstructed_behavior: paired initial co-op spawn selection and safe-spawn fallback by recovered spawn_level
idGuiSyncEntity one-bit GUI parm11 snapshot replication
idGuiSyncDoor three-bit GUI state plus shader time-offset replication
idTrigger_Teleport repeatable free-destination selection with delay and cooldown
idTurkeyPuncher per-player score commands and snapshot replication
limits: This proves source compilation, registration, map spawn and one-minute single-host survival, not activation of every recovered behavior.

Two simultaneous peers, spawn-level advancement, death/respawn/rejoin, teleport occupancy, shared-GUI contact, Turkey Puncher scoring, transitions and save/load still require functional gameplay tests.
Remaining skeleton, resource, rendering, audio, encounter and visual-fidelity warnings are outside this checkpoint.
The source and evidence commits are local because the configured GitHub remotes are not authenticated in this environment.
